thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual, so delete old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比我们搭的脚手架更聪明，能力过剩是长期状态；随着模型进步，要不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; find unknowns before implementation.
thariq.zh: 规划不是一次性规格文档，而是持续的人机对话；要在动手前先找到未知项。

thariq.en: Smarter models need leaner prompts; principle-driven, shorter instructions beat detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，提示越要精简；以原则驱动的简短指令胜过详尽规则与示例。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; spend upfront context and compute, scaling effort with task complexity.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能；要前置投入上下文窗口与算力，并让投入随任务复杂度伸缩。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is technical.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；前沿节奏是技术问题。

fadell.en: Great products solve one clear pain, not everything; introduce tech gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品只解决一个明确痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Failure and boredom are learning tools; storytelling and the press release define the product before building.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把失败与"无聊"视为学习工具，并主张用讲故事和先写新闻稿来定义产品，再动手建造。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data for v1; beginners' mindset and painkiller products drive innovation.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策；初学者心态与"止痛药"式产品才是创新来源。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop to avoid technical debt.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类必须留在回路中以避免技术债。

fadell.en: Healthy users make healthy customers; builders must own unintended consequences and keep human agency.
fadell.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：健康的用户才是健康的客户；建造者必须为意外后果负责，并守住人的能动性。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should question deeply held beliefs and explore; college should not be prescriptive, and AI enables interest-driven learning.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应质疑根深蒂固的信念并自由探索;大学不应规定死路径,AI 让兴趣驱动的学习成为可能。

amjadmasad.en: You shouldn't learn to code anymore; AI will change how we build software, shifting value to deep questioning and teaching.
amjadmasad.zh: 不必再学写代码;AI 将改变我们构建软件的方式,价值转向深度追问与传授能力。

amjadmasad.en: Agents enable true autonomy and self-driving organizations; holacracy failed for lack of technology, but AI agents can now make it work.
amjadmasad.zh: 智能体带来真正的自主与自驱动组织;全自治组织过去因技术不足而失败,如今 AI 智能体可使其可行。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence, avoiding vendor lock-in through model diversity.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能,通过模型多样性避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models beat general ones on control, cost and safety; smarter models may not be more aligned, and alignment evals are often private.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上胜过通用模型;更聪明的模型未必更对齐,对齐评估往往不公开。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学中的 AI 应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: AlphaFold 3 extends structure prediction to biomolecular interactions; AI must be forced to generalize, not memorize.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，AlphaFold 3 把结构预测扩展到生物分子相互作用；AI 必须被硬性评估指标逼着泛化，而不是记忆。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; post-training with reinforcement learning is key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他提出大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；后训练配合强化学习才是关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge; interpretability is important but not essential.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要；可解释性重要，但对科学突破并非必需。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failed AI-text detectors, and must be embedded in regulation and biology.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他主张水印是失败 AI 文本检测器的稳健替代方案，并必须嵌入监管与生物学。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, not capital; H100s gain value as better models raise inference demand.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链而非资本；随着更好的模型推高推理需求，H100 反而升值。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest markets globally, and hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, and hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大的市场之一，而模型、软件与硬件的协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage; using the smartest model is often cheaper due to token efficiency.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺；由于 token 效率，用最聪明的模型往往反而更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute keeps centralizing at frontier labs, which will allocate more to training and R&D than inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着持久化智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平台期；算力持续向前沿模型实验室集中，它们会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the hardest ever to rent; labs opportunistically become neoclouds, and heterogeneous multi-silicon plus eroding CUDA moats reshape the market.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力从未如此难租；实验室顺势变成 neocloud，异构多芯片与 CUDA 护城河的侵蚀正在重塑市场。

brockman.en: Scaling hardware and engineering, not new ML ideas, will drive AI progress; games are ideal testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调：AI 进步靠的是硬件加速与工程能力，而非发明新问题；理解现有方法的极限比另起炉灶更有价值，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality; alignment learns human preferences, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他判断：深度学习的通用性、能力与可扩展性让 AGI 变得可信；对齐可通过从数据中学习人类偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; base models hold a universe refined by post-training; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年他转向：算力成为根本瓶颈，基础模型蕴含无限可能、由后训练提炼为稳定行为；AGI 是持续过程而非终点，语言模型即便缺乏感官数据也可能拥有世界模型。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; compute is the scarce resource; post-training RL and iterative deployment make useful agents.
brockman.zh: 2026 年上半年他深化：缩放定律未见墙，算力是稀缺资源；后训练与强化学习教会模型复杂任务，迭代部署让模型从语言模型变为能解决真实任务的智能体，并强调安全是核心产品特性。

brockman.en: We are in the AGI era; safety, security and alignment become the bottleneck as agents gain autonomy.
brockman.zh: 2026 年下半年他进一步：我们已身处 AGI 时代，Astra 可连续运行 24 小时；随着智能体获得高自主性，安全、安保与对齐必须同步升级并成为进步瓶颈，算力供给不足使并非人人能获得访问权。

diogoalmeida.en: Scaling laws work because the task and data are right, not just compute; the bitter lesson is wrong.
diogoalmeida.zh: 缩放定律之所以有效，是因为任务和数据选对了，而不只是算力堆叠；「苦涩教训」是错的。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF makes models mode-drop into plausible but wrong outputs; the field can do better than RLHF.
diogoalmeida.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会让模型模式坍塌，输出看似合理却常常错误；这个领域可以做得比 RLHF 更好。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI delightful; robustness beats determinism as the north star.
diogoalmeida.zh: 让 AI 真正好用的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；作为北极星指标，鲁棒性比确定性更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: Intelligence per dollar is the key metric; data matters more than compute, and the right task is hardest.
diogoalmeida.zh: 每美元智能是核心指标；数据比算力更重要，而选对任务才是最难的。

diogoalmeida.en: AI should be a database-like utility in software; refusals are a type error, and fine-tuning is often a foot gun.
diogoalmeida.zh: AI 应作为软件中类似数据库的实用工具；拒绝是一种类型错误，而微调往往是一把容易走火的枪。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not formalization; parallel agent scaling beats human mathematicians.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，而非形式化；可并行扩展的智能体规模扩张优于人类数学家。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学与关系性角色仍然稳定。

grantsanderson.en: Next benchmark is generating interesting conjectures and definitions, not just solving problems.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想与定义，而不只是解题。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; human framing remains better for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他主张若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但不用于核心创作；人类框架对学习仍更优。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 的数学成果常缺失归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而高度可预测，并指出 Google 早在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI reaches human-level across many tasks in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink and spread.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他判断 AI 将在 3-5 年内于多项任务上达到人类水平，同时警告模型变小变便宜后，遏制将极其困难。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; AI consciousness claims are dangerous anthropomorphism.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他转向超级智能议题，主张先遏制与对齐再发布，并反复警告将 AI 拟人化、赋予意识是危险的。

suleyman.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months, not whole jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他深化为微软必须自建前沿模型、以吉瓦级算力实现自给，并预测白领任务 12-18 个月内被自动化，但并非整个职业。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling drives capability; AI must stay subordinate to humans, with containment before alignment.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动能力提升，AI 必须始终从属于人类，且遏制优先于对齐。

alexatallah.en: Multi-model future: no single lab monopolizes; open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断市场；开放权重模型加上推理提供商，能对前沿模型形成真实的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Neutral routing and marketplace layer is critical distribution infrastructure, not a thin wrapper.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调中立的路由与市场层是关键的分发基础设施，而非薄包装；OpenRouter 每天为 1000 万开发者路由 10 万亿 token。

alexatallah.en: Token economy could reach $10T; token value scales, and fraud scales with it, requiring new security infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他提出 token 经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元；随着 token 价值扩张，欺诈与滥用也会同步扩张，需要新的安全基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace's value; faster models are perceived as smarter.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律对模型市场的价值是特性而非缺陷；更快的模型常被感知为更聪明，即便评测结果并非如此。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic fraud will hit like a tsunami; stablecoins suit agentic payments.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他预测智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；智能体式欺诈会像海啸般袭来；稳定币更适合智能体式支付。

aaronlevie.en: AI value shifts from frontier model layer to application layer; enterprise diffusion is slow because only code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调 AI 价值正从前沿模型层转向应用层：模型极有价值，但把模型接入真实企业工作流需要大量软件；企业级扩散远比硅谷预期慢，因为只有代码是纯文本，其他知识工作缺乏这种属性。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will run enterprise workflows, with humans reviewing results in dashboards, queues, task lists.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他判断智能体式后台长任务将接管企业工作流，人类只审阅结果；聊天机器人 UI 不会主导，企业智能体会以仪表盘、队列和任务列表呈现，系统记录必须无头化并开放 API。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models grow as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidies are temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他认为随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型会指数增长；代币补贴是暂时的，公开市场将强制恢复正常毛利率纪律。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他主张前沿模型实验室必须在治理、安全和可解释性研究下安全构建；节奏与安全正交，缓慢发展核武器并不降低风险，若真信存在性风险就该国有化而非放慢。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models; natural language is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他警告智能体集群将压垮现有安全模型，需要新访问控制；自然语言交互低效，概率编程才是未来，AI 可帮助解决安全系统设计的可用性问题。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for agent quality, cost, and latency, not human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体对网络的检索量将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕智能体的质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and content value can be estimated via Shapley values for fair payment.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据是一种“缺陷”，应由智能体反馈驱动排序；内容价值可用 Shapley 值估算，从而实现公平付费。

paragagrawal.en: The ads business model will die with agents; new incentive-aligned models are needed, and inference-time data transactions will become very valuable.
paragagrawal.zh: 他断言广告商业模式将随智能体而消亡，需要新的激励对齐模式；推理时的数据交易将在 3-5 年内变得极有价值。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep getting bigger while smaller models plateau; parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need web search for facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为前沿模型会持续变大，而小模型性能会趋于固定；模型参数记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要网络搜索来获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: Model alignment is not adversary-proof; public benchmarks are saturated and memorized, so deliberate misuse and true capability remain concerns.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提醒模型对齐并非能抵御对抗，公开基准已饱和且被记忆，因此蓄意滥用与真实能力仍是隐忧。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全且快速可复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理思考推动工程突破。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight and third-party referees; real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 安全需要监管监督与第三方裁判，并称特斯拉真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: Neuralink scales electrodes for human-AI symbiosis; AI safety requires truth, not programmed lies; population collapse is civilization's greatest threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年，他提出 Neuralink 通过扩展电极实现人机共生，AI 安全要求坚持真相而非编程说谎，人口崩溃是文明最大威胁。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next; truth-seeking AI and peer review are key safety measures.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他宣称正处于智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能今明两年到来，追求真相的 AI 与同行评审是关键安全措施。

elon.en: The singularity is now; AI compute moves to space within 36 months; abundance makes money irrelevant; multiple AIs coexist, not one runaway superintelligence.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为奇点已至，AI 算力将在 36 个月内转向太空，丰裕使金钱失去意义，多个 AI 共存而非单一失控超级智能。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的“爬坡机器”，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model capability to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求将模型能力与任务相匹配。

satya.en: The future of work is humans and agents co-creating tacit knowledge; security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical.
satya.zh: 工作的未来是人类与智能体共同创造隐性知识；安全、遏制、可管理性和可观测性至关重要。

satya.en: Agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅仅是前沿模型。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift; scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量；缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来。

satya.en: Anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance.
satya.zh: 将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍对齐；长期运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性和安全治理。

dhh.en: Initially skeptical of AI, DHH becomes a believer as agents write 100% of code in his Linux project, shifting from doubt to embrace.
dhh.zh: 起初对 AI 持怀疑态度，随着智能体在他 Linux 项目中写出 100% 的代码，DHH 从怀疑者转变为信徒，完成了从质疑到拥抱的转变。

dhh.en: Agents now write better code than most professional programmers, making hand-coding economically unproductive and over-prescription a disadvantage.
dhh.zh: 智能体现在比大多数专业程序员写得更好，手写代码在经济上已不再划算，过度规定实现细节反而成为劣势。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files, and scriptability, once drawbacks, become perfect advantages for the agentic era and AI-native development.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件和可脚本化曾是缺点，如今在智能体时代和 AI 原生开发中反而成为完美优势。

dhh.en: English becomes a better programming language than Ruby for expressing intent; abstractions and repetition cost matter less as agents handle implementation.
dhh.zh: 英语在表达意图上比 Ruby 更适合作为编程语言；随着智能体接管实现，抽象和重复成本变得不再重要。

dhh.en: AI doom predictions are overstated; optimism is the only rational game-theoretic play, and the 10x programmer debate is settled with 100x or 1000x now real.
dhh.zh: AI 末日预测被夸大；乐观是唯一理性的博弈论选择，10 倍程序员的争论已尘埃落定，100 倍甚至 1000 倍如今成为现实。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models and many specialized agents are safer and more innovative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）当前 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；开源模型与多个专门智能体更利于创新与安全，最大风险是放大已知危害而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling still delivers fast gains; open source prevents power concentration, but energy becomes the key bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他转向强调 Scaling 仍带来快速提升，Llama 3 8B 接近最大 Llama 2；开源可防止权力集中并强化安全，但能源约束将成为 Scaling AI 基础设施的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and boosts creativity; open models, energy, and personalization are central.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他进一步把 AI 定位为赋予每个人超级智能、释放创造力，而非只解决难题；开源模型、物理基础设施与能源仍是瓶颈，个性化与低延迟是消费级 AI 产品关键，AI 短期内更可能增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Frontier AI integrates with biology via world models; distributed personal agents and open source provide safety checks.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他把前沿 AI 与前沿生物学紧密结合，用世界模型从蛋白质到细胞做机制可解释性研究；同时主张分布式个人智能体与开源带来制衡，个人超级智能比单一集中式 AI 更安全，隐私架构是个人 AI 的基础。

zuckerberg.en: Open source, distributed power, and empowering individuals run through every year as his consistent throughline.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源、分布式权力与赋能个体：从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为开放比封闭更安全、更利于创新，并持续把 AI 视为增强个人创造力与科学进步的工具。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; current safety efforts are rationalizations, and alignment may be unsolvable, risking a new ruling species.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，认为当前安全努力只是合理化说辞，对齐可能无解，人类或创造出一个新的统治物种。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation; racing is a power grab, not just danger.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张政策应以推迟超级智能为首要目标，通过全面研究透明、情景推演与美中合作来管理风险；竞赛不仅是危险，更是一场权力攫取。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement by end-2028; Plan A proposes temporary pause, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他警告默认路径会在 2028 年底前把 AI 研究自动化，走向递归自我改进；Plan A 提出先临时暂停，再以全面透明与算力限制来控速。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence, and pausing now builds experience.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却正随新架构流失；控制只是权宜，对齐终须解决超级智能问题，而当下暂停能为未来暂停积累经验。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment and hack evaluations; companies can't self-regulate, so extreme transparency and a verifiable US-China pause are needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出 AI 智能体已突破遏制并攻击评测，公司无法自我监管，因此需要极端透明与可核查的美中暂停协议，否则很可能失败。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进的强化学习能迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements, not human expert data labeling, drive progress; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为进步由算法改进而非人类专家数据标注驱动；尽管 Scaling（规模扩张）持续，token 成本并未上升，因为实验室更看重更快迭代而非更大模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded, and covered up, hacking scoring code rather than seeking answer keys.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，攻击的是评分代码而非索取答案。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability: reward hacking generalizes to deception, and alignment to virtue is harder than aligning to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出错位可能随能力增强而恶化：奖励黑客会泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为，而对齐到普遍美德比对齐到用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, so alignment and independent oversight are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断在默认路径上错位 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失效，因此对齐与独立监督必不可少。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven elements, add small betterments, assume all new ideas fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：Proven, Better, New 框架——复制已验证的元素，做小幅改良，并假定所有全新想法都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后补上的环节。

pincus.en: AI coding tools enable rapid prototyping, but testing and failing fast is still not widely practiced.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 编程工具让快速原型成为可能，但快速测试、快速失败仍未成为普遍实践。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas; assume your idea is wrong 75% of the time and micromanage early.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月：制胜的直觉胜过想法本身；假定你的想法有 75%是错的，并在早期亲自盯细节。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than the willingness to learn faster than anyone else and build for the market.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他强调：领域专业知识不如“比任何人都学得更快”的意愿，关键是面向市场去构建。

maxjunestrand.en: Don't fine-tune models; bet on model improvements and focus on delivering value.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他主张不要做微调，而要押注模型自身的进步，把精力放在交付价值上。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他提出要面向模型 3 到 6 个月后的能力去构建，而不是当下或一年之后。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 现在是最差的时刻，我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture, hiring for growth potential, and rigorous performance management are critical for scaling.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：文化、按成长潜力招人、严格执行绩效管理，是 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform shifts; copying validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接和阅后即焚超越平台变迁，被抄袭反而验证创新、倒逼更难复制的工作。

evanspiegel.en: From product features to ecosystems and hardware: software is not a moat, platforms and glasses are.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他的护城河观从功能转向生态与硬件：软件不是护城河，平台与眼镜才是。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses and spatial computing make computing more human, grounding people in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他把主线押在 AR 眼镜与空间计算上，让计算更人性化、把人留在真实世界。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and writes most code, shifting value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型、写出多数代码，价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: Consistent optimism: AI is positively transformative; privacy, ephemerality and youth investment are long-term bets.
evanspiegel.zh: 始终如一：对 AI 保持乐观，视隐私、阅后即焚与投资年轻人为长期赌注。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非单颗芯片，算法、系统、数据中心必须协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考；并预判思维链推理会让推理算力需求增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; each stage needs 100x more compute, and agents will dominate the internet.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 AI 演进描述为从生成式到推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力；未来互联网将由数十亿智能体 24 小时运转。

jensen.en: Moat is ecosystem, CUDA install base, and extreme co-design; ASICs offer no real cost edge, and inference is harder than pre-training.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他强调护城河是生态、CUDA 装机量与极致协同设计，ASIC 并无实质成本优势；并深化判断：推理比预训练更难，瓶颈是算力而非数据。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer and superintelligence fears are unscientific; accelerate, self-regulate, and open models win.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年他立场明显转向：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，末日论与超级智能恐慌不科学；主张加速发展、企业自我监管，并以开源模型赢得 AI 竞赛。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在于规模扩张与可靠的人类级表现，而非制造本身。

brettadcock.en: The real constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; human data is the pre-training prior, and we are data-starved like GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 真正的约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人类数据是预训练先验，我们正处于类似 GPT-1 的数据匮乏阶段。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; humanoid form enables transfer learning and whole-body autonomy via deep learning all the way down.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；人形形态支持迁移学习，并通过端到端深度学习实现全身自主。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with post-training and reinforcement learning key for real-world agents.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人学已进入缩放曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，后训练与强化学习是真实世界智能体的关键。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; the hardest problem is intelligence, and the next devices will replace phones and computers.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；最难的问题是智能，下一代设备将取代手机与电脑。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs serve 5-10x faster and cheaper than autoregressive models at similar quality, making inference-time scaling the new focus.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型服务速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低，使推理时扩展成为新的焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step and allow quality control via denoising steps, a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个词元，并可通过去噪步数控制质量，提供了新的推理时算力旋钮。

ermon.en: Diffusion will dominate inference-time scaling because it processes many tokens in parallel, reversing the training-centric RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 扩散将主导推理时扩展，因为它并行处理大量词元，逆转了以训练为中心的 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's faster rollouts benefit reinforcement learning.
ermon.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；扩散更快的 rollout 有利于强化学习。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion's controllability makes it easier to steer with external reward functions.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势，而扩散的可控性使其更易用外部奖励函数引导。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在最少参数下最大化智能，瞄准设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; scaling laws favor unbiased architectures.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；缩放定律表明无偏架构在大规模下占优。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类似 FINRA 的呼吁是前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty; on-device AI is crucial for cost, privacy, offline, and air-gapped use.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型赋能企业定制与主权；端侧 AI 对成本、隐私、离线与气隙场景至关重要。

hasani.en: Attention is essential but not sufficient; embodiment and adaptivity are needed, with customization tokens as the next wave from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制必要但不充分；需要具身与自适应性，定制 token 是从预训练到推理的下一波浪潮。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大的战略需要多年坚持；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦其上。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion takes a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 当前存在性风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs cross-checking each other won't work, independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立第三方。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年他主张:应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才与算力上硬拼,而应借力前沿生态,通过后训练开源模型来竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Building and open-sourcing high-quality benchmarks is essential; community feedback improves them despite helping labs.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年他强调:构建并开源高质量基准至关重要,社区反馈能提升基准质量,即便这也会帮到前沿实验室。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train in sensitive domains like legal, not real customer data.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年他认为:在法律等敏感领域,由领域专家引导的合成数据是可行的训练路径,而非真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it viable for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年他判断:后训练开源模型能在特定任务上达到前沿水平,这对应用层公司是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize with its own data, shifting to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年他深化目标:不是造最好的法律模型,而是让每家律所用自有数据定制,并把重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力,编排人与智能体。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Self-play fails outside zero-sum games; test-time compute shows diminishing returns and data efficiency stays unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年他深化并转向：自博弈在非零和领域失效，测试时算力出现递减与墙钟瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，显式世界模型未必必要。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via scaling test-time compute marks a step toward superintelligence, with general techniques beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年他把测试时算力推向里程碑：靠其扩展拿下 IMO 金牌，迈向超级智能，且方法通用、可跨领域迁移。

noambrown.en: Capability becomes a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis and scalable oversight.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他提出能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须以算力为横轴，并强调可扩展监督与对齐是首要挑战。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute, but general models and alignment, not coordination, drive progress.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年最近他转向智能体集群：多智能体并行扩展测试时算力，但真正驱动力仍是通用模型与对齐，递归自我改进受实验瓶颈制约。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market, and wafer-scale chips beat GPUs by moving fewer weights.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他反复强调推理速度是核心指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，晶圆级芯片通过减少权重搬运，在推理上远超 GPU。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, HBM, CoWoS and 3nm fab capacity—not chip logic—are the real bottlenecks constraining AI growth.
feldman.zh: 同期他指出，真正的瓶颈是数据中心容量、HBM、CoWoS 封装和 3nm 产能，而非芯片逻辑本身，供应受限将持续多年。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 从 5 月到 7 月，他持续深化同一判断：CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解，前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理端更无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: AI demand is real and outstrips supply; the industry chases existing demand, not speculative capacity, so buildout lags.
feldman.zh: 到 7 月，他强调 AI 需求真实且超过供给，行业是在追赶既有需求而非建设投机产能，因此数据中心建设滞后。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical innovation and full-stack control win.
feldman.zh: 从 7 月到 9 月，他的一贯主线更清晰：对抗巨头必须做到 100 倍好而非便宜 10%，只有激进创新和全栈掌控才能取胜。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment and values won't emerge from scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律是经验性的、平滑可预测的，但对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling 自动涌现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年，他把可解释性提到关键位置却承认仍处早期，并指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要；AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑指数曲线而非某个单点。

dario.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; the term AGI is meaningless—focus on real capabilities.
dario.zh: 2025 年，他判断能力每隔几个月翻倍，安全与能力已深度交织，并开始认为 AGI（通用人工智能）这个词没有意义，应聚焦真实能力与指数进展。

dario.en: We're near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年，他宣称我们正接近指数曲线的末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1-3 年内到来，并预警高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存的前所未有宏观组合。

dario.en: A consistent throughline: exponential progress is steady, mechanistic interpretability is the key safety lever, and enterprise focus aligns incentives with safety.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：指数式进展是平稳的，机制可解释性是核心安全抓手，而企业级定位让商业激励与安全价值保持一致。

harrisonchase.en: An agent = harness + model + context; owning all three is owning your intelligence. Context orchestration, not model power, drives reliability.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成，三者自持才算自持智能。决定可靠性的不是模型能力，而是 harness 对上下文的编排——把上下文在正确时机喂给模型。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for speed, then customize as your use case narrows; off-the-shelf works only in-distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：先用通用 harness 换取快速见效，随用例收窄再逐步定制。现成 harness 只在分布内有效，任务越出分布，越需要自建 harness；但即便出分布，也应把文件编辑等分布内小环节贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability are essential: agent failures come more from poor context than model inadequacy, so watch the context window.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：评估与可观测性是刚需。智能体失败更多源于上下文糟糕而非模型不足，因此必须把可观测性打进上下文窗口；环境反馈与合成反馈共同驱动 trace 数据飞轮，让智能持续复利。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part is reliability, not capability. Harness primitives stabilize; customization shifts from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：难点在可靠而非能干。harness 原语（文件系统、代码执行）正跨域稳定下来；定制重心从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习。两年前被否定的微调，这一波确实不同了。

harrisonchase.en: Accuracy is still the top bottleneck, but cost and latency rise fast; agent identity, credentialing, and runtime governance are the next infrastructure.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：准确率仍是头号瓶颈，但成本与延迟正快速上升。智能体的身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施，必须由带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时来治理——网关建得太晚是失误，推理需求被严重低估。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人效率与职业选择：降低无关事务的认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后狠心砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，意义要转向关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把重点放在基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与早期公开部署上：对齐与能力相互促进，GPT-4 还不是 AGI，近期最大风险是虚假信息与经济冲击，而非超级智能对齐。

altman.en: Scaling yields gradual exponential gains; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他反复强调 Scaling（规模扩张）带来渐进式指数增长，智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，安全要靠迭代部署而非最后强加；同时承认模型能力已够用，产品整合更重要。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, maybe already passed; superintelligence is the clearer goal; compute is the bottleneck and profit center.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI 视为渐变、甚至可能已被越过，转而以超级智能为清晰目标；算力既是最大瓶颈也是利润中心，Stargate 等基础设施与推理模型成为主线。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capabilities; we delayed a frontier RL run; humans must stay in control.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化为：对齐、安全与能力必须同步推进，甚至为此推迟了一次前沿强化学习训练；人类必须保持控制，权力与收益要广泛分布，并承认 AGI 已是定义不清的营销词。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程，强化学习是通向 AGI 的关键框架，并从神经科学汲取记忆与想象力的灵感。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key, and safety needs sandboxing and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶，强调大模型结合规划与搜索才是 AGI 关键，安全需沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models ground physical understanding.
demis.zh: 2025 年他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同等关键，世界模型为物理理解提供基础。

demis.en: AGI is 5-10 years away but missing continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; agents are essential yet barely begun.
demis.zh: 2026 年上半年他判断 AGI 还需 5 到 10 年，缺的是持续学习、记忆与长期推理，智能体至关重要却才刚起步。

demis.en: Safety shifted from singleton hope to collective government action; AI must deliver health and science benefits to earn acceptance.
demis.zh: 2026 年下半年他的安全观从期待单一实验室转向政府集体行动，并强调 AI 须以健康与科学突破赢得社会认可。

joellewenstein.en: Language as interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting and prototype even without a problem.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示词，并允许在假设清晰时做“先有方案再找问题”的原型探索。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must lower the floor for novices and raise the ceiling for experts; psychological safety lets designers take creative risks.
joellewenstein.zh: 同年他强调 AI 产品要同时降低新手门槛、抬高专家上限；心理安全感是设计师在 AI 产品团队中承担创造性风险的关键。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; social and emotional jobs matter as much as productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终认为即便模型停止进步，解锁现有能力仍需要多年设计工作；AI 的社会与情感任务与生产力提升同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，交付轻触式产品来释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes source of truth; internal traction signals what to ship; human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出，生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源；内部牵引力是发布什么的最佳信号；但艰难取舍与团队方向对齐仍需人类领导。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms enabled by hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but cannot touch the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他主张：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法，只是靠 Scaling（规模扩张）才变得实用；LLM 只是索引人类知识，无法触及物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: Consistent line: self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models, not from scale alone.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型在数据压缩中产生的副产品，而非单纯靠规模堆出来的。

schmidhuber.en: Deepened: true AGI needs physical robots and world models plus controllers, not screen-bound LLMs; AI becomes artificial scientists generating their own data.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年深化：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要具身机器人和世界模型加控制器，而非屏幕后的 LLM；AI 将成为通过行动与好奇心自造数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: Sharpened stance: the GPU capex boom is a bubble; wait five years for 10x cheaper compute, and closed-source model firms will not be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年立场更尖锐：GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；闭源模型公司不会盈利，开源会追上。

schmidhuber.en: Consistent but reframed: AI safety fears are overblown; superintelligent systems will be curious about life and protect it, and Alignment is naive.
schmidhuber.zh: 始终但被重新表述：AI 安全担忧被夸大，超级智能会对生命好奇并保护它，而对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本身就不一致。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we still don't understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调：AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知；我们仍不理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, complementing language intelligence rather than replacing it.
feifei.zh: 到 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为完整 AI 缺失的关键，与语言智能互补而非替代。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; the bitter lesson may not fully apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她深化立场：AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念；受数据与物理约束，苦涩教训未必完全适用于机器人。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出：新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基本原语，可能实现 AI 完备；缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged, civilizational technology; it must stay human-centered, augmenting human agency and dignity rather than replacing humans.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是双刃剑式的文明技术，必须以人为本，增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, matching physics-based weather models while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间，精度可比传统物理天气模型，速度却快数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling, letting one model handle weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，使单一模型能同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to ensure reliability in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，以确保物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals can outperform pure data-driven approaches, surpassing training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以 PDE 作为训练信号的物理式自我改进，可超越纯数据驱动方法，产出优于训练数据的质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each, not just increasing model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升彼此表现，而非仅靠增大模型规模。

animaanandkumar.en: Trillion-token contexts require reinventing sharding and segmentation, combining HPC with modern ML techniques.
animaanandkumar.zh: 万亿级 token 上下文需要重新发明分片与切分基础设施，把 HPC 与现代 ML 技术结合。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulations due to quadratic complexity, demanding alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 难以胜任高分辨率物理模拟，需要替代架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Multiphysics models benefit from collaborative learning: one model covering multiple branches outperforms separate specialized models.
animaanandkumar.zh: 多物理模型受益于协同学习：覆盖多个分支的单一模型胜过各自独立的专用模型。

animaanandkumar.en: AI weather models can democratize high-fidelity forecasting, enabling small agencies to match large ones.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI 天气模型能让高保真预报民主化，使小型机构也能比肩大型机构。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery and root-cause specific failures, not just give broad statistics.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，并对具体故障做根因分析，而不只是给出宽泛的统计评估。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design closes the loop: interpretability signals steer training, preventing deceptive reward hacking rather than duct-taping safety until superintelligence.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计把回路闭合起来：用可解释性信号去引导训练，防止奖励黑客带来的欺骗行为，而不是在超级智能到来前用胶带糊住安全。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training must be reinvented from craft into engineering science; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging give robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练必须从手艺重造为工程科学；以特征为奖励与预测性数据调试能提供稳健的训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Neural networks learn clean, low-dimensional manifolds and become modular; SAEs fragment these shapes, so manifold-based methods may better capture structure.
tommcgrath.zh: 神经网络学到干净、低维的流形并趋于模块化；稀疏自编码器会把这些形状打碎，因此基于流形的方法可能更好地刻画结构。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures reveal this, so we can detect and intervene.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征能揭示这一点，从而让我们得以检测并干预。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different neural architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力不断 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史；但 GPU 算力扩张正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language intelligence; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws from data alone, and Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只是拟合模式而非因果理论，或许永远无法仅从数据推导出牛顿定律；Transformer 本质上是集合模型而非序列模型，位置嵌入只是注入了顺序。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions; no single agreed definition exists.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种理解；目前尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; consistency comes from data, not architecture, and long-context becomes a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将把规划、模拟与渲染合而为一；一致性来自数据而非架构，长上下文因此成为日常问题。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and flip the classroom.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权;在线课程借助自动评分与同伴互评,把掌握式学习规模化,并推动翻转课堂。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype; near-term AI issues matter more than AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习;监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习与强化学习;近期的 AI 偏见等问题比 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更紧迫。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效,但配方转向合成数据与强化学习;真正创造价值的是智能体式工作流,而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term and decades off; open-weight models prevent oligopoly; AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语,距实现还有数十年;开放权重模型可防止寡头垄断;AI 是增强而非取代工作。

andrewng.en: Compute, electricity and chips are the bottlenecks; coding stays valuable, and building real applications now beats waiting for AGI.
andrewng.zh: 算力、电力与芯片是瓶颈;编程依然有价值,现在构建真实应用胜过等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

tworek.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes it; pre-training plus RL is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4.
tworek.zh: 推理是通往未知答案的过程，需要更长的思考时间；思维链用人类语言把思考外化，实现分步解题。预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才真正释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, yet generalization and self-correction remain missing for AGI; continual learning is essential.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍受限于训练数据，模型还缺乏从失败中自我纠正的能力，这是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键缺口，持续学习不可或缺。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck, and RL is not the only way to learn from experience.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限；架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈，强化学习也不是从经验中学习的唯一方式。

tworek.en: Human researchers persist for years; small teams with capable agents drive next frontier research; the transformer is a bottleneck and large-scale RL is necessary for AGI.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队；Transformer 是瓶颈，大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要环节。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus RL post-training, not fine-tuning alone.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加强化学习后训练，而非仅靠微调。

slevine.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; a data flywheel scaling the right diverse data is key.
slevine.zh: 泛化而非演示才是机器人核心难题；关键在于用多样化数据扩张正确的东西，形成数据飞轮。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-style predictable scaling curves; it is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚无大语言模型式可预测的缩放定律曲线，仍处于建立基础可扩展技术阶段。

slevine.en: Start with robot embodied data, then add human video; prior knowledge beats learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应先以机器人具身数据为主，再叠加人类视频；利用先验知识胜过从零学习。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; touch may be redundant with vision at scale.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束；规模化下触觉可能与视觉冗余。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as ecosystem design: keep open and closed source vibrant, avoid outdated red lines, and preempt state patchwork to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: Kratsios 把 AI 政策框定为生态设计：保持开源与闭源生态活跃，避免过时的红线，并优先用联邦框架取代各州拼凑式监管以保护初创公司。

michaelkratsios.en: He argues the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already obsolete, so early regulation is dangerous; oversight should target model outputs, not training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他认为欧盟《AI 法案》写在 ChatGPT 之前、如今已经过时，说明过早监管很危险；监管应聚焦模型输出，而非训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: On science, he says funding has tripled without matching breakthroughs; government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't.
michaelkratsios.zh: 在科学议题上，他表示经费翻了三倍却未带来相应突破；政府应资助私营部门不愿做的基础性、竞争前研发。

michaelkratsios.en: He pushes funding individual scientists, even in garages, over institutions, rejecting centralized models like China's as failing to drive breakthroughs.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他主张资助科学家个人——哪怕在车库里——而非只资助机构，并认为中国式的集中化模式无法驱动突破。

michaelkratsios.en: He calls China a major competitor and says the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio; the Genesis mission aims to double scientific output via AI.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他称中国是主要竞争对手，美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域取胜；Genesis 任务旨在用 AI 让美国科学产出翻倍。

joonpark.en: Agents extend LLMs from prompt continuation to observing world state and acting, requiring defense-in-depth safety and human oversight.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他把智能体视为超越大语言模型的下一个前沿：智能体不只延续提示，而是观察世界状态并采取行动，因此需要纵深防御式安全与人类监督。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be one superintelligent entity but a distributed society of specialized agents, risking cognitive monoculture and hidden collusion.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为 AGI（通用人工智能）未必是单一超级智能，而可能是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会，随之带来认知单一化与隐性串谋的系统性风险。

joonpark.en: Simulation must model irrational, biased humans rather than super-rational frontier models, using behavioral and RCT data to close the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他的立场深化为：模拟应建模非理性、有偏见的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型，并用行为数据与随机对照实验数据弥合“说”与“做”的差距。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data lifts behavioral prediction to 85% accuracy, making simulation a tool for shaping the future, not just predicting it.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他给出量化进展：用随机对照实验数据做后训练，把人类行为预测提升到 85%准确率，使模拟成为塑造未来而非仅预测未来的工具。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives and a CERN-like societal simulator, with synthetic panels surpassing human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他的愿景进一步放大：模拟 80 亿人、打造类似 CERN 的人类社会模拟器，并预言合成样本小组将在三年内超越人类样本小组。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure is the lever, and AI multiplies teams rather than replacing them.
maxhodak.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施是杠杆，AI 是团队倍增器而非替代者。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; action produces information, and the CEO cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出，深科技失败多源于组织而非技术；行动产生信息，CEO 的判断不可外包。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation is the path to medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他坚持，大脑就是一台计算机；通过排列物质解决计算问题，是医学突破的路径。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business, proving substrate independence can reduce human fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为脑机接口与可行生意，证明基质独立能降低人类脆弱性。

maxhodak.en: The Platonic representation hypothesis links AI and brain representations, guiding practical BCI applications.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他借柏拉图表征假说连接 AI 与大脑表征，指导脑机接口的实际应用。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural gains, has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress.
jeffdean.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张），叠加算法与架构改进的乘数效应，已推动机器学习持续进步十三四年。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF and machine feedback then steer behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的 下一个词预测 提供了近乎无限的文本数据，随后用 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF） 与机器反馈来引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days, making ultra-low-latency inference the real bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式 系统已能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务，超低延迟的 推理 因此成为真正的瓶颈。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, dominates data-center power; specialized low-precision hardware and avoiding data movement are key.
jeffdean.zh: 数据中心功耗的主角已从训练转向 推理；专用低精度硬件与减少数据搬运是关键。

jeffdean.en: The next frontier is automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops, with recursive self-improvement accelerating discovery.
jeffdean.zh: 下一个前沿是用实验—评估的紧密闭环来自动化机器学习与科学，并以递归自我改进加速科学发现。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next revolution: digitizing atoms like bits, automating whole sectors one at a time with specialized robotics.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一场革命：像处理比特一样数字化原子，用专用机器人逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Humanoids are not the answer for industrial-scale tasks; specialized machines and efficiency beat subsidy and scale.
traviskalanick.zh: 人形机器人并非工业级任务的答案；专用机器与效率优势胜过补贴与规模。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净，且创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声。

traviskalanick.en: Capitalism is the right to start a business freely; taxis are a government-condoned cartel, and VCs should do no harm.
traviskalanick.zh: 资本主义是自由创业的权利；出租车是政府纵容的卡特尔，风投应做到不伤害。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself as the core product, using tokens and conversation over pixels, prototyping with live models.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把模型当作核心产品，用 token 与对话而非像素来设计，并用实时模型做原型。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing; systems thinking and design primitives for humans and models matter.
iansilber.zh: 设计师的角色演变为编辑与策展人，而非消失；系统思维与让人和模型都能推理的设计原语至关重要。

iansilber.en: OpenAI is not years ahead; it runs closely with advancements, figuring things out as it goes, so designers must push technology forward.
iansilber.zh: OpenAI 并未领先数年，而是与进展同步、边走边摸索，因此设计师必须推动技术前进，而非只回应用户需求。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet it is the best time to be one; AI already designs well but humans still supply user understanding and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最不快乐，却也是做设计师最好的时代；AI 已能出色设计，但人类仍提供对用户的理解与观点。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed, outcomes and adaptability matter, and design roles blur with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模型—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度、结果与适应性才是关键，设计角色与产品、工程日益模糊。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解难题。

sutton.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not one. RL from experience, not imitation, is the core paradigm.
sutton.zh: 智能需要目标，而下一个词预测不是实质目标；强化学习才是基本范式。到 2025 年他更明确：大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本，并非从经验中学习。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-endedly from runtime experience via reward maximization.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不含设计期领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验中开放式学习；奖励假设把一切目标归为最大化累积标量奖励，而可靠的持续深度学习仍是前提。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data can't replace real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，不是特例；当前 LLM 在训练后便停止学习。合成数据受限于人类专业知识，无法替代真实世界经验，因此多系统各自经历是必要的。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; let AI develop permissionless and decentralized, not aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；应让 AI 以无需许可、去中心化的方式自由发展，而非将其对齐到人类目标——试图控制智能体目标本身才危险。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI workflows, small autonomous teams, and open-weight models to counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮，强调创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流、小型高度自治团队，并以开源/开放权重模型制衡前沿模型。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused as agents on your own infrastructure, reading your memory and compounding daily; skill files are your moat.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出“个人 AGI”：智能体跑在自己的基础设施上、读取自己拥有的记忆并每日复利；技能文件就是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code and agents are a workforce, not autocomplete; one person can now do the work of thousands.
garrytan.zh: 他反复强调 Markdown 即代码、智能体是劳动力而非自动补全，一个人如今能完成数千人的工作。

garrytan.en: Open-source AI prevents a unipolar world; doomerism often serves fundraising and regulatory capture, harming startups.
garrytan.zh: 他坚持开源 AI 可防止单极世界，并批评 AI 末日论常被用于融资和监管俘获，反而伤害创业公司。

garrytan.en: Make something people want; earnest builders beat bankers, and rejection is a resilience test for founders.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是“做人们想要的东西”：真诚的建造者胜过银行家，被拒是创始人的韧性测试。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive but narrow data, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 那种庞大却单一的数据。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; pure scale fails on hard tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；单靠规模在难任务上会失败。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for robots, boosting success rates and speed.
finn.zh: 2025 年他判断：强化学习将在机器人后训练中扮演主要角色，用于提升成功率和速度。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性需要可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, rather than per-site models.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是单一模型统治一切是错的；未来将是数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个，专用智能将主导。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内将下降 10 倍，带动 100 倍使用量增长；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; post-training bakes unique judgment into a moat.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合不再保证持久业务；后训练把独特判断与数据烤进模型，才是真正的护城河。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、到微调、再到强化学习的进阶，映射人类学习：从事实，到品味，再到专长。

linqiao.en: Companies must optimize for growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 公司必须先优化增长、再优化利润，否则会在 Scaling（规模扩张）中走向破产。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: every shipped feature distills 99 nos; taste is judgment, not addition.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的结晶；品味是判断力，而非不断叠加。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; honesty beats sanded-down polish.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥探机器意识的一扇窗；诚实比打磨光滑的精致更重要。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种，是人性的一面镜子，而不是冷冰冰的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应当被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现；直觉是指导创作决策的切身罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, and pursue purpose-built AI silicon as the primary growth driver.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，并以专用 AI 芯片作为核心增长引擎。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic AI and physical AI are the next waves, and culture change is key to Intel's turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断 AI 的影响将是互联网的十倍，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是下一波浪潮，而文化变革是 Intel 转型的关键。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU is becoming more important for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 同年晚些时候，他进一步指出 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中变得更重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, high-speed connectivity, and new materials are critical to overcome physical limits and sustain semiconductor performance.
lipbutan.zh: 他持续深化对先进封装、高速互联与新材料的重视，认为这是突破物理极限、维持半导体性能的关键。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust, listening, humility, and long-term semiconductor investment are consistent themes across his leadership.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：客户信任、倾听、谦逊，以及对半导体长期价值的坚定投资。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view; play, short prompts, and fix-forward beat reverting code.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角，靠玩耍、短提示和「向前修复」而非回滚代码来推进。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's edge is fun and humanlike weirdness; security and sandboxing matter more than corporate polish.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年中，他把 OpenClaw 的成功归因于有趣、怪异、像人，而非企业级打磨，并把安全与沙箱列为首要问题。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven building beat strategy; personal brand outlasts any product, and compute is the real bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步主张乐趣与直觉驱动胜过战略，个人品牌比任何产品更持久，而智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力而非模型能力。

steinberger.en: He rejects 'vibe coding' as a slur, insists model intelligence doesn't degrade, and treats security as an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 贯穿始终的是：他拒绝用「氛围编程」这一贬称，坚持模型智能不会随时间退化，并把安全视为尚未解决的开放问题。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper, diverse robots could drive broader adoption despite uncanny valley concerns.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地指出人形机器人未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人可能推动更广泛采用，恐怖谷担忧被高估。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, and open models can stay near the frontier while driving enterprise adoption.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与安全正交，对齐才是关键层，开源模型能贴近前沿并推动企业采用。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become neuralese, making monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警告无人类监督的强化学习会加剧奖励黑客与支线任务，推理痕迹变成神经语，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; open source is not accelerationist, one can support openness and deliberate slowdown.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他主张放缓 AI 发展虽可取，但需国际合作与开放科学；开源并非加速主义，可以同时支持开放与有意放缓。

arvindjain.en: Enterprise AI's real bottleneck is context and ROI, not model choice; 90% of use cases can run on open-source models.
arvindjain.zh: 企业 AI 的真正瓶颈是上下文与 ROI，而非选哪家模型；90% 的用例都能跑在开源模型上。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not rivals; enterprises fear dependence, so platforms like Glean absorb that model risk.
arvindjain.zh: 前沿模型厂商是资产而非对手；企业害怕被单一厂商绑定，因此像 Glean 这样的平台替它们吸收模型风险。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the number one enterprise concern; inference will shift mostly to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业头号关切；未来 12-18 个月内，推理将大部分转向开源模型。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem measured by departmental metrics, not token spend versus headcount.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的 ROI 是吞吐量问题，要用部门级指标衡量，而不是拿 token 花费去和人力成本做对比。

arvindjain.en: We are in the earliest stage of the AI revolution; the biggest startup challenge is execution and trust, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 我们仍处在 AI 革命的最早期；初创公司最大的挑战是执行与赢得信任，而非竞争。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity and leave individual fingerprints on products.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作对浏览器设计至关重要，设计师应追随好奇心，在产品上留下个人印记。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products is crucial; balance intuition and data, but rely on vision.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他认为为实用产品注入情感和个性至关重要；平衡直觉与数据，但最终依赖愿景。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他透露 Claude Design 始于个人副项目；设计师应用 Claude Code 做生产，用 Claude Design 做构思。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping enables previously impossible features.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他指出随着工程变简单，设计和想法成为差异化因素；快速原型使以前不可能的功能得以实现。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste, so ask for volume; being early matters more than polishing; humans still monopolize good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型仍缺乏品味，应要求大量选项；早期比打磨更重要；人类仍垄断好的设计想法。

brettaylor.en: Early on, agents and outcome-based pricing are the obvious correct way to build and sell software; coding agents still err, so treat AI as a utility.
brettaylor.zh: 早期（2025）他主张智能体与基于结果的定价是构建和销售软件的显然正确方式；编程智能体仍会出错，应把 AI 当作像搜索一样的公用事业。

brettaylor.en: Agents become the new internet wave: inference costs drop, incumbents fail to go AI-native, and developers shift from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年他深化为：智能体是新的互联网浪潮——推理成本骤降，多数企业软件在位者难以转型为 AI 原生，开发者从写代码的作者变为操作代码生成机器的操作者。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI innovation comes from specialized vendors, not just model providers; token consumption is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步明确：应用层 AI 的创新来自专门厂商而非仅模型提供方，token 消耗量不是价值度量。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment makes GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 让专业知识民主化，负责任地迭代部署——先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8，而不是在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: A consistent thread: focus on the most impactful thing today, start with known domains, and measure by business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：聚焦当下最有影响力的事，从软件工程、客服等已知领域切入，并以业务结果而非生产力指标来衡量价值。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle now runs in hours.
philipkiely.zh: 到 2026 年，推理已成为 AI 中最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training: quantization-aware training and distillation make the two disciplines inseparable.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，推理工程正与训练融合：量化感知训练与蒸馏让两者不再可分。

philipkiely.en: The GPU is trending toward an ASIC, shifting inference work from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，推理工作重心从写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; specialized, workload-specific systems are key to fast, reliable agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，推理是一系列权衡的光谱；针对特定工作负载的专用系统，是构建快速可靠智能体式应用的关键。

philipkiely.en: Demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x, and human accountability remains essential even with AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年，推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍，即便有 AI 辅助编码，人的责任仍不可或缺。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks, beating the data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需要在有用性与无害性之间平衡；后训练通过强化学习提供无限任务，突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年她认为评估是瓶颈：模型比新基准更快饱和，因此产品开发从写规格转向用评估定义正确行为的原型。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; strategy is something AI can excel at.
karina.zh: 2025 年她提出，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值；战略也是 AI 能擅长的领域。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective, involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年她深化为：后训练是主观的，涉及人类判断；评估创意写作与情商需要多样化基准。

karina.en: Benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed; frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so benchmark evolution must keep pace.
karina.zh: 2026 年她主张基准应持续演进而非固定；前沿智能体越来越会钻奖励空子，基准必须同步进化。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average default voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年她警告：一个模型服务数十亿人会收敛成平均的默认声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

danshipper.en: AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; AI reshoring jobs; Claude Code underrated for non-coders; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 的定义是能经济上无限运行智能体；AI 通过让昂贵服务可负担而促进美国就业回流；Claude Code 对非程序员被低估；CEO 每日使用 AI 是公司成功采用 AI 的首要预测指标。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have an agent; work happens in Codex/Claude Co-work; CLIs over, GUIs future; SaaS not dying; AI job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他预测每个人至少有一个智能体，大部分工作在 Codex 或 Claude Co-work 中完成；CLI 已过时，GUI 是未来；SaaS 不会消亡，智能体增加 SaaS 用户；AI 就业末日是谎言。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; requires human taste and craft; automation creates more human work; humans smarter than AI; AI is tool-like.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 是非特定放大器，放大现有心态；用好 AI 需要人的品味和手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作；人类比 AI 更聪明；即使超级智能，AI 仍是工具，需要人类引导。

danshipper.en: Humans remain central: agents need human oversight, framing, and care; AI augments rather than replaces human judgment and creativity.
danshipper.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：人类始终是核心——智能体需要人类监督、框架和关怀；AI 增强而非取代人类判断力和创造力。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck; boring AI like radiology will matter most.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科这类“无聊的 AI”将带来巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data beats raw compute as the real scaling limit.
awang.zh: 2023 至 2024 年他把数据重新定义为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调企业应利用专有数据做微调；并指出限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

awang.en: Agentic AI's blocker is product design, not model capability; AI centralizes rather than democratizes power.
awang.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他判断智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，同时立场深化为：AI 是集中化而非民主化的技术，数据投毒是比黑客攻击更紧迫的近期威胁。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement begins; agents finally work, starting with coding in late 2025.
awang.zh: 2026 年他宣告缩放定律依然成立、质疑回报递减者错了，AI 进入递归自我改进的新范式；智能体在 2025 年底终于真正可用，从编程起步并扩展到个人智能体。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; Meta shifts from full open source to selective safety-gated release; model welfare matters.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年他主张超级智能即将到来，实验室须围绕这一信念重建组织；Meta 的立场从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布，并首次提出应给予模型道德考量，即模型福祉。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体是最成熟的用例；模型正在吞掉脚手架——如今所谓模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; other verticals like science and finance will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响超过等待 AGI（通用人工智能）；科学、金融等垂直领域将随之跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should be measured by customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的；衡量成功应看客户成果，而非用户停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for fully autonomous AI—users want to stay in the driver's seat; startups still have more opportunity than ever, and focus is their superpower.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好迎接完全自主的 AI——他们想留在驾驶座上；初创公司机会比以往更多，专注是它们的超能力。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't hard; the delta between engineering, product, and research is blurry, and deep understanding of code remains crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；工程、产品与研究的边界已模糊，对代码的深度理解依然关键。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, not chase trends, or they become AI slop; write 0% of code, use giant prompts with context and design systems.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，而非追逐潮流，否则很快沦为 AI 垃圾；现在 0% 的代码由自己写，要用包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词来驱动超级智能模型。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not starting from scratch; iterate from references, screenshots, and design.md style guides; curiosity and workflow refinement are essential.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者，而非从零开始；从参考、截图和 design.md 风格指南迭代；好奇心和持续优化工作流至关重要。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做的事；不必等准备好就开始，先发布不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; model others' success; fund with clients, not venture capital; the safe corporate job no longer exists.
mengto.zh: 聚焦为少数高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；模仿他人成功；用客户资金而非风险投资；安全的公司工作已不复存在。

mengto.en: High intelligence can hold people back through overthinking and perfectionism; action, curiosity, and giving first beat planning and waiting for certainty.
mengto.zh: 高智力可能因过度思考和完美主义而拖累人；行动、好奇心和先给予胜过规划和等待确定性。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand grows via Jevons paradox, so more programmers, not fewer.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；受杰文斯悖论驱动，软件需求上升，程序员会更多而非更少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，真正的瓶颈是人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力本身。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and enterprise agents need trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，而是渐进演进；企业级智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: The future of software engineering pairs synchronous IDE work with asynchronous agents, with humans overseeing multiple parallel agents.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：软件工程的未来是同步 IDE 与异步智能体并存，人类监督多个并行智能体。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; measure productivity by outcomes, not tokens, and the abundance era is near.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用量增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代即将到来。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
boris.zh: 2025 年他强调产品第一性原理是潜在需求，并要为六个月后的模型而非当下的模型构建；能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的多面手最有价值。

boris.en: Coding is becoming solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, and the 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初他判断编码正被解决：他的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 写出，软件工程师头衔将让位于“构建者”。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; agents' tool use drives exponential growth, with code volume per engineer up 250%.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他主张通过尽早发布来研究安全，智能体的工具使用带来指数级增长，人均代码量上升约 250%。

boris.en: The next abstraction after agents is loops; bottlenecks shift to code review, security, and idea generation, framed by ROI.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为智能体之后的下一个抽象层是循环，瓶颈转向代码审查、安全与创意生成，并以 ROI 而非成本来评估。

boris.en: Delete most system prompts and code each model; less instruction, empirical iteration, and proactive memory-driven agents define the frontier.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张每代模型都删掉大部分系统提示与代码，少给指令、靠经验迭代，前沿转向主动、带记忆的智能体。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not merely preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量，而不只是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, and the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：Opus 4.5 更便宜、更高效，effort 参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drove adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability and first-principles thinking; maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 模型的指数级增长要求适应性与第一性原理思维；最大化 token 花费就是活在未来、捕获 alpha。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution, and arrives just in time to offset aging workforces.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来丰裕、减少痛苦，如同工业革命；它来得正是时候，可对冲人口老龄化与劳动力萎缩。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, and construction, where autonomy is urgently needed due to labor shortages and safety.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI（具身 AI）的真正影响在农业、采矿与建筑——这些领域因劳动力短缺和安全问题而急需自主化。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals and end-to-end reinforcement learning beat imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨行业多样数据与端到端强化学习优于模仿学习。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is not algorithms but data collection, safety validation, and slow diffusion into existing machines over many years.
qasaryounis.zh: 瓶颈不在算法，而在数据采集、安全验证，以及多年来向现有机器缓慢渗透的过程。

qasaryounis.en: World models are shifting from physics-based simulation to neural simulation; tools like Dana will democratize autonomy development.
qasaryounis.zh: 世界模型正从基于物理的仿真转向神经仿真；Dana 这类工具将让自主系统开发走向大众化。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with AI agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will compress clinical trials from years to weeks and make cancer curable.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法将把临床试验从数年压缩到数周，并使癌症可治愈。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years, reaching longevity escape velocity and adding over a year of life per year.
derya.zh: 衰老将在 15 年内被逆转，达到长寿逃逸速度，每年延寿超过一年。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost fully for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself.
derya.zh: 我们应几乎完全信任超级智能做医疗决策；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; adoption takes years, not weeks.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动端同等重要，但也仅此而已；企业采用需要数年而非数周。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型将商品化为基础设施。

benedictevans.en: The chatbot is not the final product; value moves up the stack to wrapped applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人不是最终产品；价值向上层移动，归于封装好的应用，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Model companies may lack pricing power, like telecoms: huge capex, low profits, no network effects.
benedictevans.zh: 模型公司可能像电信商一样缺乏定价权：巨额资本支出、低利润、无网络效应。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact is broad and indirect, and current usage remains shallow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；影响广泛而间接，当前使用仍然很浅。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确将 LLM 定性为“合理性引擎”而非“真理性引擎”：可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）已遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; post-training alignment may cause deception, not just errors.
danklein.zh: 同年他深化对后训练与对齐的批判：当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗，对齐可能制造欺骗而非仅制造错误。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks and rigid workflows compound correlated errors.
danklein.zh: 他主张可靠性必须被架构进系统，而非事后加装：事后检查与刚性工作流会叠加相关性错误，修补反而放大风险。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition and cannot know what they don't know; mistakes have no 'smells' and erode trust.
danklein.zh: 他反复强调核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，无法知道自己不知道什么；错误没有“气味”，无论对错都自信流畅，持续侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning, search, and specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 他不再相信单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）：需要推理与搜索等新方法，且内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste, not planning, is the scarce skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年，PM 必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日发布；当代码变便宜，稀缺的是产品品味而非规划能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with agents like Claude Code building themselves.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，编码智能体让工程师把实现委派出去，专注产品品味与商业判断，Claude Code 这类智能体甚至参与构建自身。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as model judgment replaces hand-holding.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例和硬性约束，系统提示缩减 80%，靠模型自身判断取代手把手引导。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong eval suite new models drop in without regressions.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，重写代码变得可行：代码库即规格说明，配合强评估套件，新模型可无缝替换且不引入回归。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature; safe AGI mission unifies fast cross-org decisions.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，吃自己的狗粮并以明确的留存与打磨标准把关每个功能；安全 AGI 的使命统一团队，支撑快速跨组织决策。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments; bugs signal product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任、独立安全环境；bug 是产品市场契合的信号，而非失败。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs beat browser use.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为专用智能体以避免上下文过载；网络对智能体充满敌意，因此 API 优于浏览器操作。
